SettingRow.Title: Look
SettingRow.Description: A theme of the player, or a look of Raven: Windows, macOS, GNOME, glass, high contrast.

SettingRow.Title: Accent from the cover
SettingRow.Description: The color of the controls follows the cover of what plays.

SettingRow.Title: Accent
SettingRow.Description: The color of the controls, when it does not follow the cover.

SettingRow.Title: Background
SettingRow.Description: What moves behind the panels, in the colors of the cover.

SettingRow.Title: Animate the background
SettingRow.Description: Off, the background stays still and the window draws only when something changes.

SettingRow.Title: Now playing panel
SettingRow.Description: The panel on the right, with the cover and what comes next.

SettingRow.Title: Normalize the volume
SettingRow.Description: The same loudness for every song.

SettingRow.Title: Streaming quality
SettingRow.Description: Nothing is streamed: the songs of this player are made up.

Border.Label:
**Raven Music** is a showcase of Raven: no server, no sound, only the interface.
- every part is an XML file of `ui/`, brought in with `<Include>` - the cards, the rows and the tiles are tags declared in `widgets.xml` - `<Icon>`, `<Cover>`, `<Visualizer>` and `<Heading>` are made by the application - the themes are files of `themes/`; the accent follows the cover playing - the island at the top lives in the notch of a MacBook
